args.title: Issue 4406: change src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parseStatement function in src/ingest/parser.ts removes a final empty line but then processes all lines. The assertShape call throws 'Malformed row' if the number of columns does not match the header, which happens when an empty line is present and parsed. This explains why files ending with an empty line fail on the last row with a 'Malformed row' error.
